title: Adamandite
description: A new ore that adds new better armor than netherite.
body:
Adamandite ore is an powerful endgame material that is beyond better than netherite 

The Adamandite ore adds a rare and valuable material

New set of tools that has better durability and stats

Full armor set stronger and better than netherite but harder to get.

Why donwload Adamandite if your modapck or you need a better late game Tools and armor i recommend this mod.
